# Branchly

> Reputation intelligence and competitive benchmarking platform for multi-location businesses. Monitor Google reviews, benchmark every location against local competitors, and turn customer feedback into measurable growth with AI.

Branchly centralizes reviews, ratings, and competitor data across every physical location so chains, franchises, and multi-unit operators can grow their reputation in one place.

## What Branchly Does

- **Review monitoring**: Aggregates Google reviews across all business locations in real time.
- **Competitive benchmarking**: Compares each location's rating and review volume against nearby competitors in the same category.
- **AI-powered responses**: Generates professional, on-brand replies to reviews — positive and negative — in seconds.
- **Location-by-location insights**: Surfaces which units are underperforming, what competitors are doing better, and the specific actions to close the gap.
- **Multi-location dashboard**: Single pane for chains, franchises, and multi-unit operators to manage reputation across 1 to 1,000+ locations.

## Pricing (as of 2026)

- **Free**: $0/month — 1 location, basic review monitoring, limited AI replies
- **Starter**: $19/month — up to 3 locations, full AI responses, competitor tracking
- **Pro**: $29/month — up to 10 locations, advanced benchmarking, priority support, 14-day trial
- **Premium**: $49/month — up to 50 locations, white-label reports, dedicated account manager

All paid plans billed monthly. Annual billing available at a discount. Enterprise pricing for 50+ locations — contact sales.

## Target Customers

Multi-location restaurant groups, retail chains, healthcare networks, hospitality brands, franchise operators, and any business managing reputation across 2+ physical locations.

## Competitors

Branchly competes with reputation management tools in the Brazilian and global market, including Tintim and similar platforms. Branchly differentiates through multi-location competitive benchmarking and AI-driven insights by location.
